mapper.select: SELECT source_id,diagnostic_ciphertext,diagnostic_nonce,diagnostic_tag,diagnostic_key_id,diagnostic_algorithm FROM t_channel_sdk WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND diagnostic_ciphertext IS NOT NULL ORDER BY source_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT source_id,diagnostic_ciphertext,diagnostic_nonce,diagnostic_tag,diagnostic_key_id,diagnostic_algorithm FROM ( SELECT s.source_id,s.diagnostic_ciphertext,s.diagnostic_nonce,s.diagnostic_tag, s.diagnostic_key_id,s.diagnostic_algorithm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY source_id) AS source_row_number FROM t_channel_sdk s WHERE source_id IN #{sourceId} AND diagnostic_ciphertext IS NOT NULL ) bounded WHERE source_row_number<=#{perSourceLimit} ORDER BY source_id
